evaluation_components.notes: 1 Surprised and 3 Announced, best score of three quizzes will be considered out of 4 quizzes, Closed book

attendance_policy: Each student is expected to attend all classes and appear in all evaluative components.
makeup_policy: Make-up for mid-semester and comprehensive exams will be given only for very genuine cases, and prior permission must be obtained from IC. No makeup will be given for quizzes under any circumstance whatsoever.
